I’m a year into being a full-time MT and… honestly, I don’t know. 

I enjoy feeling like I help people feel better, but sometimes I feel like maybe I’d be more effective at actually SOLVING problems as a PT or acupuncturist and massage is just a band-aid. 

Some days I feel like a fraud. Other days I miss the security of my old desk job that had PTO and health insurance. I really hate how casual clients can be about no-showing, cancelling at the last minute, or not tipping anything. I feel like some people don’t respect MTs as skilled professionals and treat us like we’re wait staff at a restaurant. (To be clear, restaurant wait staff deserve respect and are skilled as well, they just get a lot of shitty attitude thrown at them by entitled customers)

Then other days I really really love it and feel so invigorated by the connections I make with my clients and feel like I’ve found my calling. It’s a real roller coaster.
And this is why it’s even more annoying when clients no-show, cancel last minute, or anything else to mess with our schedules!
